SCHEDULE 13D
CUSIP Number: 59162A100
Name of Issuer: MetroGrid Energy Corp.
Title of Class of Securities: Common Stock
Ticker: MGE
Exchange: NYSE
Date of Event Which Requires Filing: February 10, 2026
Name of Reporting Person: Harbor Ridge Capital Master Fund Ltd.
Sole Voting Power: 8,500,000
Shared Voting Power: 0
Sole Dispositive Power: 8,500,000
Shared Dispositive Power: 0
Aggregate Amount Beneficially Owned by Each Reporting Person: 8,500,000
Percent of Class Represented by Amount in Row (11): 12.4%
Item 4. Purpose of Transaction
The Reporting Person acquired the shares for investment purposes. The Reporting Person intends to engage with the Board and management regarding operational performance, capital allocation, governance changes and potential board representation. The Reporting Person may seek to nominate directors and may encourage the Issuer to review strategic alternatives, including a sale or merger.
Item 5. Interest in Securities of the Issuer
The Reporting Person beneficially owns 8,500,000 shares, representing 12.4% of the outstanding common stock.
SIGNATURE
